Sweep of RiemannMasullo/Ch05_ThetaZSpaces/Sec5_Printed.lean (prover, working by hand). Plan: F = ℚ, S = {5}, W = trivial-character chart image of [2,3]; test = (archimedean bump at 1) ⊗ 1_{1+5ℤ₅}, x = class of h − (1,−1)·h. Every weight in W is 1 on the norm-one idele (1,−1), so each eigendistribution kills x, while theta(x) at 1 equals 1.
